verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents its own workflows that move documents from source connectors to destinations, plus job APIs to trigger runs, monitor status and inspect failures. That shows server-side pipeline execution you can trigger and leave running, but the evidence covers only one-off triggered runs, not recurring schedules or event-driven autonomous automation. missing for 10: documented recurring scheduling or event-based triggers, evidence that workflows run unattended without manual or API triggering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Track and control the processing jobs that execute your workflows. Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
